wants.topic: Divine interventions & tests of devotion for poor/oppressed devotees during major festivals (Navratri, Laxmi Pujan)
wants.evidence: GuruVaani Studio's Maa Durga videos (Maa Durga working for old woman vsNormal 1271.31, steptmother story vsNormal 195.43) and Divya Katha Marathi's Laxmi Pujan & Ghatasthapana stories (vsNormal 13.22, 8.44).

wants.topic: Addressing core theological/philosophical questions in simple Hindi (e.g., Why many gods in Sanatan Dharma)
wants.evidence: Bk Usha Motivational video 'हिंदू धर्म में इतने भगवान और दूसरे धर्म में एक ही भगवान क्यों ?' achieved vsNormal 185.49 (1.45M views on a 12k sub channel).

wants.topic: Folk-mythological 'Swayamvar' & impossible divine task stories (Ordinary boy vs Arrogant Princess/Raja)
wants.evidence: THE BH STORIES multiple uploads of 'घमंडी राजकुमारी का स्वयंवर: 5 असंभव शर्तें' consistently beating channel median by 10x to 29x vsNormal.

wants.topic: Acts of selfless kindness/hospitality by poor characters resulting in sudden miraculous blessings
wants.evidence: GK Hindi Stories 1m video 'प्यासे मुसाफिर को गरीब लड़की ने पानी पिलाया' reached vsNormal 864.92 (9.4M views).

gaps: Stories bridging emotional domestic struggles (stepmother abuse, extreme poverty) directly with scriptural Hindu miracles, rather than standard lecture-style kathas.
Theological Q&A (like why multi-deity worship exists) narrated through engaging story arcs rather than monologue motivational speeches.
saturated: Dry historical origins of festivals without emotional character narrative (e.g., standard Rakshabandhan origin or generic Shravan Somvar vrat kathas).
Generic Aghori horror/mystery clickbait stories (e.g., Hostel Room 13, Aghori mysteries performing at vsNormal 0.00).
Abstract academic Vedic debates (e.g., Karma Yoga vs Sanyasa Yoga without narrative framing).
